subject: Cartistry POC — concise results + one-line quote request
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cartistry.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cartistry POC — concise results + one-line quote request

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the POC last month. We ran a final pass on the telemetry and pulled the most robust metrics from the three-week window (stable traffic pattern). High-level snapshot:

- Median end-to-end inference latency: down ~45% vs your pre-POC baseline (p50).
- Throughput: ~3.2x sustained increase for identical batch sizes.
- Cost per 1M tokens: ~28% lower compared to the previous self-hosted setup (same quantization profile).
- Availability (pilot window): 99.95% with KV cache enabled for repetitive queries.

I attached a one-page summary (Cartistry_poc_metrics_summary.pdf) with the data cut and measurement notes.

Quick ask: would Cartistry be willing to provide a very short quote we could use in a customer highlight? Two options: a one-line blurb we can publish, and/or a quick 15-minute call for a 1–2 sentence soundbite we can record (we use written quotes if you prefer). If you’re willing, we’ll send over a consent stub to sign — nothing legal, just marketing permission.

Proposed windows (PDT): Thu 4/18 09:00–10:30 or Fri 4/19 13:00–14:30. If neither work, tell us a slot and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — happy to tighten any metric language if you prefer different phrasing.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachment: Cartistry_poc_metrics_summary.pdf (1 page, PDF)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cartistry.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cartistry POC — concise results + one-line quote request

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear summary and thanks to your team for the tight run. A couple quick items before we finalize a public blurb:

- The ~28% cost reduction sounds right directionally. Can you confirm the baseline you used for that comparison (instance types / quantization / token mix)? Our finance team will want the baseline called out if this goes on our site.

We’re happy in principle to provide a short quote. Here's a draft one-liner from my side that I can sign off internally: 

"Redwood halved our tail latency while lowering per-request costs, enabling us to ship a better conversational experience at scale. — Priya Shah, CTO, Cartistry"

If you can confirm the baseline note above, I’ll route the one-liner through legal/marketing and approve it. I can also do a 15-minute call — Thu 4/18 09:15 PDT works for me.

Attaching a quick internal snapshot (Cartistry_internal_kpi_snapshot.xlsx) that the team used for comparison.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
CTO, Cartistry
priya.shah@cartistry.com

Attachment: Cartistry_internal_kpi_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cartistry.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2028 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cartistry POC — concise results + one-line quote request

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the proposed one-liner — that reads well. To confirm the cost baseline used in our summary: we compared against Cartistry’s reported pre-POC self-hosted setup (4x A100-equivalent nodes, float16 runtime, no KV cache, identical traffic replay). The 28% delta reflects total inference spend for the sampled period after accounting for throughput increases (same workload mix). You’ll find the exact configuration and measurement windows referenced on page 1 of the attached PDF (Cartistry_poc_metrics_summary.pdf).

If your finance team prefers a more conservative framing we can present a range ("~25–30%" or "up to 28%"), or we can remove the exact percentage and keep it qualitative.

We’ve penciled Thu 4/18 09:15 PDT for the 15-minute call with Stephanie and Priya. If that’s confirmed, we’ll send a calendar invite and a short consent note for publishing the quote.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

On Wed, Apr 17, 2028 at 09:04 AM Priya Shah <priya.shah@cartistry.com> wrote:
> Hi Stephanie —
> 
> Appreciate the clear summary and thanks to your team for the tight run. ...

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cartistry.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2028 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cartistry POC — concise results + one-line quote request

Stephanie / Marcus —

All good on our side. Legal and marketing approved the one-liner with a minor edit (keeps it tight and accurate):

"Working with Redwood Inference reduced our tail latency by ~45% and cut per-request cost by roughly 30%, enabling us to scale conversational features without degrading SLAs. — Priya Shah, CTO, Cartistry"

I’ll join the 15-minute call at 09:15 PDT today. Please send the invite. I attached a signed consent stub for marketing (signed-reference-consent.txt).

Happy to be a quick reference — let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Priya

Attachment: signed-reference-consent.txt (consent note, signed)
